verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to pick the model powering a session, and it does not show models from other providers. The only related item is a mention that teams can access Claude Code through 'a cloud provider' (claude-code-docs-55). That describes authentication and access, not a choice of model from different vendors. Community mentions of Opus and Sonnet refer to Anthropic's own models and do not document a selection feature.
